L76@P3: 1 Scope/适用范围:
L77@P3: The purpose of this document (“Document”) is to specify the specifications of the Lithium ion rechargeable battery
L78@P3: cells with AMPACE Part Number 21700A (“Product” or “Cell”) to be supplied by AMPACE to Customer under
L79@P3: Customer’s purchase order and AMPACE’s confirmation relevant to the Product. For the avoidance of doubt, the
L80@P3: specifications specified herein do not apply to any Host Device, apparatus, instrument, equipment or hardware device
L81@P3: containing Product or Cell (“Host Device”).
L82@P3: 本产品规格书描述了 AMPACE依据客户采购订单生产的可充电锂离子电池芯的产品性能指标，AMPACE 产品
L83@P3: 代码号 21700A (“产品” 或 “电芯”)。为避免疑问，本产品规格书不适用于任何包含该产品或电芯的主机设
L84@P3: 备、仪器、仪表、器件、硬件设备等（“主机”）。
L85@P3: 2 Model Number/型号：
L86@P3: 21700A
L87@P3: 3 Standard Environmental Test Conditions/标准环境测试条件:
L88@P3: 3.1 Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this Product Specification are conducted at below conditions:除非特别
L89@P3: 指定，本产品规格书所有的测试遵循如下条件：
L90@P3: Temperature/温度: 25±2℃ (“Temperature Condition”/“温度条件”)
L91@P3: Humidity/湿度: 65±20% RH (“Humidity Condition”/“湿度条件”)
L92@P3: 3.2 Throughout this Document, numeric criteria annotated by “*” means such criteria are only applicable to fresh unused
L93@P3: product within 30 days from manufacture by AMPACE. Products either have been used or stored for a period longer than
L94@P3: 30 days by Customer and/or its customer may exhibit an inferior numeric parameter than such criteria. Customer agrees
L95@P3: that such occurrence does not constitute nonconformance of specification.
L96@P3: 在本产品规格书中，所有标有“*”的项目是指仅适用于“未使用的且从AMPACE制造日起30天内的产品”。如果产
L97@P3: 品已被客户使用或存储时间超过30天，可能表现出低于标准规格，客户同意并接受产品不构成不符合规格。

L266@P6: 5.2 Mechanical Abuse Tests/机械滥用测试:
L267@P6: No. Items/项目 Test Method and Condition/测试方法和条件 Criteria/判定标准
L268@P6: 5.2.1
L269@P6: Drop Test
L270@P6: 跌落测试
L271@P6: Each fully charged Cell is dropped three times from a height of
L272@P6: 1.0m onto a concrete floor. The Cells or batteries are dropped
L273@P6: so as to obtain impacts in random orientations.
L274@P6: /将满充电后的电芯从 1.0m 高度自由跌落至水泥地面上 3
L275@P6: 次。电芯跌落时应保证在每个随机方向均受到冲击。
L276@P6: No fire
L277@P6: /不起火
L278@P6: No explosion
L279@P6: /不爆炸
L280@P6: 5.2.2
L281@P6: Vibration Test
L282@P6: 振动测试
L283@P6: A Cell is to be subjected to simple harmonic motion with
L284@P6: amplitude of 0.8mm (0.03inch) [1.6mm (0.06inch) total
L285@P6: maximum excursion], The frequency is to be varied at the rate
L286@P6: of 1 hertz per minute between10 and55 hertz, and return in not
L287@P6: less than 90 or more than 100 minutes. The Cell is to be tested
L288@P6: in three mutually perpendicular directions. For a Cell that has
L289@P6: only two axes of symmetry, the Cell is to be tested perpendicular
L290@P6: to each axis.
L291@P6: 在电芯上施加振幅为 0.8mm 的简谐振动，最 大行程为
L292@P6: 1.6mm。振动频率从 10Hz~55Hz 间以 1Hz/min 的速率变化。
L293@P6: 频率变化范围为从 10Hz 升至 55Hz，然后再从 55Hz 返回
L294@P6: 到 10Hz 。每个安装位置（振动方向）上的振动应在
L295@P6: 90±5min 内完成。按照相互垂直的三个方向进行振动试验。
L296@P6: 对于只有 2 个对称轴的电芯沿着轴向和径向两个方向进行
L297@P6: 振动试验。
L298@P6: No fire
L299@P6: /不起火
L300@P6: No explosion
L301@P6: /不爆炸
L302@P6: 5.2.3
L303@P6: Shock Test
L304@P6: 冲击测试
L305@P6: The Cell is to be secured to the testing machine by means of a
L306@P6: rigid mount which supports all mounting surfaces of the Cell.
L307@P6: Each Cell shall be subjected to a total of three shocks of equal
L308@P6: magnitude. The shocks are to be applied in each of three
L309@P6: mutually perpendicular directions unless it has only two axes of
L310@P6: symmetry in which case only two directions shall be tested.
L311@P6: Each shock is to be applied in a direction normal to the face of
L312@P6: the Cell. For each shock the Cell is to be accelerated in such a
L313@P6: manner that during the initial 3milliseconds the minimum
L314@P6: average acceleration is 75g (where g is the local acceleration
L315@P6: due to gravity).The peak acceleration shall be between
L316@P6: 125and175g.Cells shall be tested at a temperature of 20±5°C
L317@P6: (68±9°F).
L318@P6: 电芯通过刚性的方法固定在测试机器上，该方法应能支撑
L319@P6: 电芯。所有固定面。电芯要承受等值的三次冲击。冲击应在
L320@P6: 相互垂直的三个方向上实施，至少有一个方向应当垂直于
L321@P6: 水平面。电芯承受的加速度应满足如下方式：在最初的 3ms
L322@P6: 内，最小平均加速度为 75g，峰值加速度在 125g 和 175g 之
L323@P6: 间。电芯应在 20±5°C 的环境温度下进行测试。.

L326@P6: No explosion

L333@P7: 5.3 Electrical Abuse Tests/电滥用测试:
L334@P7: No. Items Test Method and Condition Criteria
L335@P7: 5.3.1
L336@P7: Forced-Discharge
L337@P7: 强制放电测试
L338@P7: A cell in a multi-cell application shall withstand polarity
L339@P7: reversal without causing fire or explosion. A discharged cell is
L340@P7: subjected to a reverse charge at 1 Cmin for 90min.
L341@P7: 多电芯应用中的电芯应能抵抗极性反转而不起火和爆炸。
L342@P7: 完全放电的电芯以 1 Cmin 反向充电 90min。
L343@P7: No fire
L344@P7: /不起火
L345@P7: No explosion
L346@P7: /不爆炸
L347@P7: 5.3.2
L348@P7: External Short Test
L349@P7: 外短路测试
L350@P7: Each test sample Cell, in turn, is to be short-circuited by
L351@P7: connecting the positive and negative terminals of the Cell with
L352@P7: a circuit load having a resistance load of 80±20mohm.The Cell
L353@P7: is to discharge until a fire or explosion is obtained, or until it has
